title: Acknowledgement Guarantee Service Credits under Sentinel Managed Security
content:
**Clause 1 (Breach).** An acknowledgement guarantee of a Sentinel Managed Security subscription is breached when the minutes between detection and acknowledgement exceed the tier's acknowledgement figure for the severity at acknowledgement.

**Clause 2 (Entitlement).** A breach earns a credit only where the tier shows credit eligibility, the severity is among the tier's credited severities, and the client claims it.

**Clause 3 (Claim window).** A credit must be claimed no later than the tier's claim window in calendar days after the incident is acknowledged. The window is counted in calendar days from the acknowledgement date, that date being day 0, and a claim on the last day is timely. The acknowledgement moment is the one recorded on the incident in the SOC's incident records, matched by incident number.

**Clause 4 (One credit).** An incident earns at most one credit; a credit already posted for the same incident number means no further credit is earned for it.

**Clause 5 (Amount and monthly maximum).** Each credit equals the tier's credit-per-breach percentage of the monthly fee of the month of detection, rounded to the cent. Credits for one month never exceed the tier's monthly maximum percentage of that fee: the remaining headroom is that maximum percentage of the fee, rounded to the cent, less the credits already posted for that service month, and a credit larger than the headroom is reduced to the headroom, never below zero. The monthly fee used is the one invoiced for the service month in which the incident was detected, and the credit is recorded against that service month. For every tier the percentage and the maximum are that tier's own figures.

**Clause 6 (Application).** Credits apply to the next monthly invoice and are never paid in cash.

## Breach boundary (hypothetical figures)

| Acknowledgement figure for the severity at acknowledgement | Minutes from detection to acknowledgement | Breached? |
|---|---|---|
| 15 minutes | 15 | No |
| 15 minutes | 16 | Yes |

The severity compared is the one at acknowledgement: an incident detected as high and acknowledged as critical is measured against the critical figure.

## Claim window boundary (hypothetical 10-day window)

| Acknowledged | Day 0 | Last timely day | Claim on 11 March | Claim on 12 March |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 1 March | 11 March (day 10) | Timely | Not timely |

## Monthly maximum, worked through (hypothetical fee and percentages)

Monthly fee of the month of detection 1000.00 USD; credit per breach 10 percent; monthly maximum 25 percent, which is 250.00 USD.

| Credited incident in that month | Credit before the maximum | Credits already posted for the month | Headroom | Credit posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First | 100.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 100.00 |
| Second | 100.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 100.00 |
| Third | 100.00 | 200.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| Fourth | 100.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Conditions taken together

A credit is earned only when all of the following hold: the guarantee was breached; the tier shows credit eligibility; the severity at acknowledgement is a credited severity; the client claims it within the window; and no credit has been posted for the incident before. If any one does not hold, the breach earns no credit.
